theme: The coast your boldest achievers earned

linkedin.text:
There is a specific moment on a top-performer trip when the reward stops being abstract. It is usually not the dinner or the gift. It is the first time the coastline comes into view and somebody goes quiet.

This is southern Italy, from a programme we ran there. A terrace above the Tyrrhenian, the whole group facing the same water.

Top-performer tiers are the hardest brief in incentive travel, because the audience is small, senior and hard to impress — they have already been somewhere nice on their own money. What works is not more luxury. It is access: a table that cannot be booked online, a boat that leaves before the day-trippers arrive, a dinner in a place that holds forty people and never advertises.

That is the layer we build. The coast is doing its own job already.

Designing a top-performer trip for 2026? Tell us who is going and we will design backwards from them.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure
